knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the owner buys a stable tank they can see and the certainty that someone is checking it. Your hourly rate, tank tools and business age are not what the client buys.
The lesson says a guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford, or it damages the business. Unlimited, undefined or impossible guarantees are not sound.
The lesson says any measured claim needs your own readings or other evidence behind it. A famous endorsement, a discount or no evidence do not support a measurable claim.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
